plan.title: Chatbot vs. AI Agent
plan.subtitle: Understanding the key differences

slides.heading: What is a Chatbot?
slides.body: A chatbot answers questions and chats based on set rules or learned data. It waits for you to ask before it responds.

slides.heading: What is an AI Agent?
slides.body: An AI agent plans and takes actions on its own to reach goals. It doesn’t just wait—it decides what to do next.

slides.heading: Why Does It Matter?
slides.body: Agents can handle complex tasks and adapt over time, while chatbots work best for simple conversations. Both use AI differently.
